title: Mangrove Loss Slowed 45%, But 3.6 Million Hectares Vanished
hook: Mangrove destruction slowed, but coastlines already lost a vast shield.
closing: Protection is working, yet every missing mangrove still leaves coastal communities more exposed.
question: Can protection catch up?

segments.say: Mangrove area fell to 15.2 million hectares, removing part of coastlines' natural storm barrier.
Asia lost 1.9 million hectares of mangroves, the largest regional loss shown.
Annual mangrove loss slowed to 102 thousand hectares. Protection can reduce destruction before it fully stops.
